card.title: Only You Can Know
card.instruction: Treat one person as the only safe place for your honest reactions, while hiding how much their discretion determines what you can risk.

transfer.action: I move {prop} to your chair and close the nearby door.
transfer.opening: Only you get my honest version. Everyone else gets the polite one. {request}
transfer.response: Officially, put me down as engaged. This is just us having coffee. {counter}
transfer.challenge: I'll leave your comments out of my report.
transfer.closing: Thanks. That standing ovation felt like a hostage video. More coffee?

originalTransfer.action: I move {prop} to your chair and close the nearby door.
originalTransfer.opening: Only you get the rest of this sentence. {request}
originalTransfer.response: I need to know these words stop with you. {counter}
originalTransfer.closing: I can tell them the weather. This needs your particular quiet.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
